items.description: Laptop accidental damage repair (cracked screen and lower-right corner), combined line paid direct to shop
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (swerve in a conveyance) and 2.6.3(a)/(b) as one loss on one unit; 7.1.12 allows a combined line and direct settlement without changing cover. No purchase price, deductible or sub-limit is stated, so the figure is an estimate taken from the reference cases (screen about 808 plus corner about 342, and 1166 on a similar laptop).
